verdict.rationale: Rive ships agent-facing tooling (an MCP server, a CLI, and RML), so asking whether agents can test in an isolated sandbox is a fair question, but the evidence documents no sandbox or test environment separate from production. Revision history, which keeps restores non-destructive by copying a revision, is an adjacent undo/versioning feature, not sandbox isolation. The sandbox.mintlify.com server belongs to Mintlify's sample spec, not to Rive.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
